incoming.title: {{name}} is waiting
incoming.body: Start the lesson? Declining automatically in {{seconds}}s.

signedOut.title: Please sign in
signedOut.body: Sign in with the account that booked this lesson.

notFound.title: Lesson not found
notFound.body: This lesson does not exist, or it is not yours.

notCallable.title: No classroom for this lesson
notCallable.body: Only confirmed online lessons have a video classroom.

early.title: The classroom is not open yet
early.body: It opens 10 minutes before the lesson — in {{countdown}}.

over.title: This lesson has ended
over.body: The classroom closes 15 minutes after the lesson ends.

permission-denied.title: Camera and microphone blocked
permission-denied.body: Allow access in your browser's address bar, then reload this page.

no-device.title: No camera or microphone found
no-device.body: Connect a camera and a microphone, then reload this page.

unavailable.title: Camera unavailable
unavailable.body: Another app may be using it. Close it and reload this page.

errors.generic: Something went wrong with the call.
errors.connection-failed: The connection dropped. Try entering again.
errors.answer-failed: Could not connect to your teacher.
